Variance commentary — Aug-26, as submitted

Net revenue

Net revenue is $52k below forecast, primarily due to a revenue recognition reassessment for Project Hawk VF3. Revenue previously forecast as Professional Services in the QSR (Lot 3 software rewrite) was determined to be non-distinct and is therefore being recognised as part of the SaaS bundle over the remaining contract term. This creates a permanent Professional Services revenue shortfall versus QSR. Full quarter update is a gap of $122k driven by the revenue recognition assessment noted with the reminder relating to timing difference on PS project implementation, being pushed back to Q4.

Net revenue

No additional material upsides or risks are currently anticipated; however, revenue remains subject to timing of project delivery, contract activity and customer requirements.

OPEX

Operating expenses were £42k/$68k above QSR, primarily due to AI-related costs (£20k AI token usage) and £22k related to AI Accelerator and Quadrants recharges not included in QSR. Q3 overspend vs QSR of $274k primarily driven by restructuring costs of £150k/$200k not included in QSR plus QTD overspends on AI tokens and Quadrants/AI Accelerator costs.
